# robotstxt.org/
#
# An admin console has no business in a search index, so this disallows everything rather than
# naming a handful of API paths the way the generated file did. Two other layers say the same thing
# — deploy/prod-server/hc-admin.conf answers /robots.txt itself so the answer survives the container
# being down, and it sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow — but this one is the only one that
# travels with the application, and it is what answers anywhere those two are not in front of it.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /
